# task\-w02a\-process\-adapter — W02a: portable bounded process adapter for Git reads
status: todo  priority: 1  scope: scope-git
readiness: not_eligible  reason: status_todo

Add one portable adapter for the new Git inspection code, callable from Bun and from the supported Node fallback, using argument arrays, bounded execution and output, structured errors, and no shell interpolation\. The current Git helper calls Bun\.spawnSync unconditionally and returns only an abbreviated HEAD, so it cannot serve the new callers and must not be used as the resolver for the new feature\.

## Acceptance
- The adapter produces identical results under Bun and under the Node fallback for the same inputs, and the Node path is exercised by a focused test rather than assumed\.
- Time and output bounds are enforced and yield a coded diagnostic instead of a truncated or partial success\.
- No argument is interpolated into a shell string, and repository paths containing spaces and Windows separators work\.
- One module owns the adapter, and existing dashboard\-only Git usage is not silently rerouted\.
